nodes.name: Pushover -> Darrell
nodes.notes: REPLACE the credentials reference: in n8n UI, create a Credential of type 'HTTP Header Auth' OR just paste your Pushover token + user key directly into the body parameters (replace the {{ $credentials.* }} references). Pushover token is the App API Token from https://pushover.net; user is your User Key from the Pushover phone app.

nodes.name: ntfy -> family-ops
nodes.notes: Only fires if ntfyFamily is non-null. URL uses container DNS (ntfy:80) since n8n + ntfy are in the same compose network. If you split them later, change to http://192.168.1.26:8081/family-ops.

meta.description: Reads PROJECT-TIMELINE.md from GitHub at 7AM each morning, filters items due in next 48h plus everything in_progress / blocked, sends a Pushover digest to Darrell and a family-visible digest to the ntfy 'family-ops' topic. Per max-forward-motion: runs daily, drives notifications, until items are marked shipped in the timeline file.
